content:
elaine: Hey all — after today's redwoodctl update my interactive auth keeps timing out when running `redwoodctl local serve --profile=staging`. Browser window opens briefly then closes, then device-code fallback times out.
ajay: ugh. windows or mac?
elaine: macOS 13.6 (arm). Tried with and without `--no-browser`.
samir: can you paste the log snippet? Is it the device code flow or the callback server failing?
elaine: here's the last bits from `~/.cache/redwood/ctl.log`:
```
INFO Starting local auth callback server on http://127.0.0.1:36271
ERROR auth: callback server never received code, timed out after 30s
WARN falling back to device code flow
ERROR device flow: poll timed out (http 408)
```
jess: do you have any proxies / vpn running? sometimes the callback can't bind if another process grabbed the port.
elaine: none. `lsof -i :36271` shows nothing. Also noticed the token ended up in the wrong profile (default) even though I specified `--profile=staging`. so my `redwoodctl local serve` is running with creds from default and failing tests.
ajay: that profile swap bug rings a bell — I think it occurs when the interactive flow is interrupted and the credential writer falls back. @samir any idea?
samir: mm I saw a flaky race where the writer uses the env var REDWOODCTL_ACTIVE_PROFILE during async completion; if the CLI spawns the browser and the parent process gets a signal the env can revert. I'll triage.
elaine: workaround I used: `REDWOODCTL_ACTIVE_PROFILE=staging redwoodctl auth login --no-browser && redwoodctl local serve --profile=staging` — forces correct write but painful.
devex-bot: :white_check_mark: Issue filed #DEVEX-2187 with logs attached (assigning to samir). Please add repro steps if you hit this.
samir: thanks — I'll reproduce on mac arm and add a unit to ensure the writer is atomic and respects `--profile`. Also will increase callback timeout a bit and add clearer error message.
elaine: thanks. if anyone else hits it please drop `--debug-auth` output here.
ajay: fyi, I hit a different but related thing on Windows where `askpass` prompts never appear in WSL sessions. suspect common root.
samir: noted — I'll link the Windows note to the ticket. planning to ship fix in next patch release and add a CLI flag `--auth-retry` so scripts can auto-retry.
elaine: awesome, ty everyone :pray:
